title: USS Omaha sphere as a heat source going behind the horizon

tellings.quote: But if you zoom in on the video, I think it actually looks more like it's actually going it's actually a heat source that is expanded.

related.note: Both are about the July 2019 USS Omaha sphere video off San Diego, but this telling explains it as an ordinary heat source dropping behind the horizon, not an anomalous craft.

plain: In July 2019 a US Navy warship, the USS Omaha, filmed a round object off San Diego, California, that seemed to drop into the sea. A well-known UFO skeptic, Mick West, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that if you zoom in on the video it looks more like a distant heat source, blurred and spread out by the camera, that is passing behind the horizon. If he is right, the video would show something ordinary far away rather than a strange craft.
